task.title: Step 02b: implement RND-UI-05, RND-UI-06, GRD-UI-06, GRD-UI-07 (PW-13 + PW-16 batch 19)
task.description: Implement the 4 frontend features per the validated design at src/design/pw13-pw16-batch19-20260813.md. Pure frontend batch — no backend changes; APIs (API-10 rate-limit, PD-08 X-Resource-Version) already released.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 components implemented per §5 of the design (RateLimitBackpressure, StaleVersionError/ConflictResolver, a11y gate, FieldFactory ARIA)
§12 error taxonomy behaviour respected (every mode handled)
data-testid attributes match §5 (rate-limit-backpressure, conflict-refetch, conflict-merge, conflict-discard, draft-banner, task-row, confirm-dialog-confirm/cancel)
typecheck / lint / build all pass (pnpm type-check, pnpm lint, pnpm build exit 0)
No mock implementations; real REST paths from §5 (PATCH /api/v1/definitions/{id}, GET /api/v1/instances, GET /api/v1/tasks/inbox, POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/complete)
FieldRegistry integration with defaultBuiltinRenderer fallback (per CMP-UI-05 contract)
axe-core config: color-contrast NOT disabled, rule timeout 30s, fail on critical|serious
Report path: tests/reports/report-<UTC-date>-<run_id>.yaml with BLOCKER exit if write fails

result.summary: Implemented RND-UI-05 (RateLimitBackpressure + Retry-After wiring on 8 pages), RND-UI-06 (ConflictResolver + StaleVersionError + definitionDraftStore + DraftBanner + 409 X-Resource-Version capture in api/client.ts + DefinitionEditorPage full stale-version callbacks), GRD-UI-06 (axe baseline config + a11yGate runner with verifyBackendReachable + impact->severity decision matrix + YAML report writer with atomic write + BLOCKER-on-fail) and GRD-UI-07 (FieldFactory ARIA wiring + fieldRegistry routing per CMP-UI-05 + DynamicFormRenderer aria-busy in try/finally + aria-validator dangling-reference detector). 129/129 unit tests pass (includes 9 new tests for RND-UI-05/06/GRD-UI-06/07 contracts + the aria-validator + the a11yGate decision matrix + the reportWriter YAML output); pnpm tsc --noEmit / pnpm lint / pnpm build all exit 0. 4 new E2E specs added (rnd-ui-05, rnd-ui-06, grd-ui-07, a11y-gate) for the running backend harness — they test.skip gracefully when @axe-core/playwright is not installed so the unit-test pipeline is unaffected.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER (WF-02 Step 3) — design the test specs that exercise the new E2E surfaces (rate-limit conflict, 409 stale-version, axe-core gate) before TEST-RUNNER executes them against the running backend.
